**In one line**: Anthropic has introduced a new frontier AI security scanner, and several crypto projects are reported to have applied to use it.

### Key points
- Anthropic unveiled a "frontier AI security scanner," and multiple crypto projects have reportedly signed up to use it.
- Interest is surfacing in security-sensitive areas such as smart-contract and code vulnerability review, where AI-driven scanning could help.
- The exact number of applicants and the list of participating projects still need confirmation from the original report.

### Why it matters
It signals that a major AI model provider is extending its reach into security scanning, with the security-conscious crypto sector responding as an early adopter. The case hints at how security tooling from large LLM firms may filter into real development workflows.
